name: betterscreenshot-dev
author: Codex & Miner
description:
Capture high-resolution world screenshots with one click from an OverlayUI button or hotkey.
Large maps are rendered in chunks to avoid texture-size limits, with size hints and optional progress status.

通过 OverlayUI 按钮或快捷键一键生成高分辨率世界截图。
超大地图会自动分块渲染，规避纹理尺寸限制，并提供截图尺寸提示与可选进度状态。
